trust_decision.summary: Untrusted block input text (user/LLM output) is matched by regexes whose cost must stay linear in input length; CodeExtractionBlock decides this in its fence patterns (overlapping \s+ followed by lazy .*? / [\s\S]*? with no closing fence gives polynomial backtracking, repeated per language alias).
